title: A routine turned on while the owl writes is described as on, never as a draft (Greek)
pins: The owl suggests a routine; the person turns it on in Routines while the model writes its reply. The reply written over the old state is discarded (routine_refreshed) and the turn writes again from the routines note, so the person never reads 'saved as a draft' about a routine that is on. From the 0.18.0 changelog: an owl's reply says how its routines are now.
